+import json
+import os
+
+_CACHE = {}
+
+def _load_spec():
+    path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "rules.yaml")
+    if path in _CACHE:
+        return _CACHE[path]
+    with open(path, "r") as f:
+        text = f.read()
+    spec = json.loads(text)
+    _CACHE[path] = spec
+    return spec
+
+def _cond_matches(cond, value):
+    if not isinstance(cond, dict):
+        return value == cond
+    for op, operand in cond.items():
+        if op == "eq":
+            if value != operand:
+                return False
+        elif op in ("ne", "neq", "not_eq"):
+            if value == operand:
+                return False
+        elif op == "in":
+            if value not in operand:
+                return False
+        elif op == "not_in":
+            if value in operand:
+                return False
+        elif op == "gt":
+            if not (value is not None and value > operand):
+                return False
+        elif op == "gte":
+            if not (value is not None and value >= operand):
+                return False
+        elif op == "lt":
+            if not (value is not None and value < operand):
+                return False
+        elif op == "lte":
+            if not (value is not None and value <= operand):
+                return False
+        else:
+            if value != cond:
+                return False
+    return True
+
+def _rule_matches(rule, x):
+    when = rule.get("when", {})
+    if not when:
+        return True
+    for field, cond in when.items():
+        if field not in x:
+            return False
+        if not _cond_matches(cond, x[field]):
+            return False
+    return True
+
+def solve(input_dict):
+    spec = _load_spec()
+    rules = spec.get("rules", [])
+    priority = spec.get("priority")
+    if priority:
+        order = {rid: i for i, rid in enumerate(priority)}
+        ordered = sorted(rules, key=lambda r: order.get(r.get("id"), len(order)))
+    else:
+        ordered = rules
+    for rule in ordered:
+        if _rule_matches(rule, input_dict):
+            return rule.get("action")
+    return spec.get("default")
